answer: Time-locked reputation deposits: every new agent escrows 25 POA for 40 epochs before it can earn. A crystal-clear ledger records each lock, so a vine of fifty clones must tie up 1,250 POA, growing linearly with every fake. Any auditor can stake 3 POA to dispute an island of suspiciously correlated accounts; proven shared control burns all their deposits and pays the auditor.
